compiled_rule.technosphere_information_loss: Retain all 29 original producer entries and useful-heat shares in the Swiss central/small-scale non-natural-gas heat market. Replace the incorrect single heavy-fuel-oil-furnace candidate with the complete source fuel/technology portfolio supplied by reviewed native processes, per MJ useful heat. All shares, including the tiny nonzero biomethane-microturbine entry, remain unchanged and sum exactly to one. Each native supplier references positive one MJ. Add no fuel, heat, operating electricity, boiler, solar equipment, storage or cogeneration credit on top of the complete native inventories. No normalization or yield, efficiency, capacity, area or calorific-value multiplier. Native light-fuel-oil boiler capacities and condensing/modulation classes match. Native 15kW wood-pellet heat replaces source 9/25kW; native 15/50kW log furnaces replace source 30/100kW; native ordinary historical technologies replace source 2014 state-of-the-art variants. Source quantities remain per useful MJ, not plant counts. Species, moisture, emissions and fuel-use differences remain unquantified. Generic industrial chips use complete native hardwood-chip heat as an explicit species proxy, without inventing hardwood/softwood shares. Explicit hardwood/softwood forest-chip entries keep the named species. Source generic evacuated-tube solar uses the native 10.5m2 heat-pipe configuration; other solar duties use the corresponding complete native Cu-collector systems. Area, storage, vintage and operating differences are unquantified. Both biogas-engine source entries use the complete native exergy-allocated biogas-engine heat service, replacing source feedstock/certification/allocation portfolios. Upgraded-biomethane microturbine heat uses native biogas microturbine heat at the same 100kWe nominal technology as a gas-quality/upgrading/allocation proxy; the native xx label/vintage remains. No separate gas-quality correction, upgrading burden or electricity credit is added. Native technology, fuel supply, grade, allocation, geography, delivery, vintage, internal uncertainty and documented BAFU biosphere exclusions differ. Preserve signed caller quantities, formulas and supported uncertainty and separate caller inputs/emissions. Inventory and LCIA equivalence are not established. Only the exact inspected ecoinvent 3.9 cut-off market is approved. No new foreground or recipe-source omission, zero-burden authority, inverse or cross-system-model route, reconstructed generation inventory or Python source/test edit.
